emails.subject: Welcome to GlyphisIO BBS
emails.body2: I am Glyphis, the sysop. I observed your entry.
emails.body3: The encryption you bypassed was not trivial. That indicates potential.
emails.body4: Identify yourself. Reply with your chosen username.
emails.body5: Type 'username: ' followed by your alias. Tab to SEND. Execute.

emails.subject: Identity Acknowledged
emails.body2: I have monitored your digital footprint. You show promise, but promise is not proof.
emails.body3: Your access is restricted until you demonstrate utility.
emails.body4: A simulation has been unlocked in the games listing.
emails.body6: Complete it. Then we will discuss your future.

emails.subject: SIMULACRA CORE // Assessment Complete
emails.body2: SIMULACRA CORE has processed your run.
emails.body7: Do you feel you have a purpose in this constructed reality?

emails.subject: SIMULACRA RUNNER // Audio Ops Waiting
emails.body2: I see you're doing well over on SIMULACRA_CORE. It's tough but once you get it, it's pretty basic after that, trust me.
emails.body3: My advice: don't underuse the WAIT command. Sometimes the pause before the jump is the difference between the desperate and the determined.
emails.body4: We haven't met. I'm uncle-am - pirate radio, audio, general safety round here. Admin logs say you rode in on a slick BRADSONIC 69000 BATTLESTATION!?
emails.body5: Tell me it's the black loadout!? Obsidian chassis. Cyan monitor. Mmmmmmm!
emails.body6: I did a sweep through your settings (we see everything, wooo!) and I notice that you ain't got your soundcard configured? Well, good news: I'm halfway through a driver to pump crisp audio into that elegant stock RADLAND soundcard of yours.
emails.body7: On your side I need you to dig out the soundcard manual (you better not have thrown it away...F4), and pump in the ASM to power up those obsidian BRADSONIC speakers.
emails.body8: Boy will they sing for you baby!
emails.body9: If you can script, I can compile, I've got OP clearance from rain.
emails.body10: Head into URGENT OPS when you're ready for the task.
emails.body11: After we have that saved on my side we could possibly get my Pirate Radio packet stream going! You won't believe the stations we can get online! SORRY! haha, I'm getting carried away. Baby steps uncle-am, you gotta code for me first!
emails.body12: Catch you in the editor, I'll drop in some comments now and ping rain to unlock the section for ya,
emails.body14: P.S. That RADLAND card deserves a voice. Let's give it one.

emails.subject: RE: Soundcard Task // Network Radio Packet Relay Request
emails.body2: Nice work on the LAPC-1. You handled that way better than most first-timers. You really have skills and the equipment we need!
emails.body3: Since you've got a good feel for the BRADSONIC now, and as we were discussing, I've got another job for you.
emails.body4: The group's got a few low-power stations out there that need help passing their data around the network. Relay hops to keep the underground radio network from going dark. Your system's got the RAM and the stability to do it.
emails.body5: Glyphis has the software, it's a pretty impressive bit of kit straight from the spooks on our tail. If you agree, your BRADSONIC will act as a quiet relay node. No broadcasting, no shouting into the airwaves, just listening, buffering, and handing the packets off. In return, you'll get access to the full underground spectrum: you'll be able to tune into the revolutionary night-time talk stations, the drift channels, the dj's playing banned songs like the one you buffered earlier.
emails.body6: Yeah, it's very very illegal. But after Glyphis took what we needed they corroded that place down. I think that so long as we keep it subtle, it stays invisible, it's a cool part of what we do and I want you to be a part of it.
emails.body7: If you want in, just reply and I'll flip your access flag - then it'll just be a case of patching the tones and the airwaves are yours!
emails.body8: Looking forward to hearing from you!

emails.subject: SIGNAL INTERFERENCE // Trust is a Vulnerability
emails.body2: The network is noisier than usual. Static in the encryption. Shadows in the logs.
emails.body3: glyphis_IO was built on anonymity, but anonymity is easily compromised by those who know what to look for.
emails.body4: I have detected unauthorized probes. Someone is mapping our node structure.
emails.body5: Assume everything you type is being intercepted. Assume every 'friend' is a potential leak.
emails.body6: Paranoia is not a defect. It is a security feature.

emails.subject: RELAY ACCESS GRANTED // Your Progress is Noted
emails.body2: I have monitored your completion of the tone patching sequence. Your progress within the group has been noted.
emails.body3: Uncle-am has reported that he is particularly impressed with the skills you have displayed. That is not a statement he makes lightly.
emails.body4: I must acknowledge the risk you have taken. You have sacrificed your own safety in order to keep the underground pirate waves alive. That sacrifice does not go unnoticed.
emails.body5: Glyphis_IO still has secrets under its sleeve. Tools and capabilities that remain hidden from the surface.
emails.body6: Provided that you continue to help with getting banned radio and games to the people of Tokyo, then soon you will see real hacking action. With yours truly.
emails.body7: The tool you just used to access the radio network - that packet sniffer - I acquired it from the CIA. It is a powerful piece of equipment. I almost got caught retrieving it. I could have used a friend helping on the other nodes. Perhaps in the future, who knows...
emails.body8: However, I must warn you: agents are operating on other BBSs. They monitor. They record. They wait.
emails.body9: Should you discover the numbers of additional BBSs, tread lightly. You never know who is watching.
emails.body10: They are recording our every step.
emails.body11: Trust no one. Question everything. Stay vigilant.
emails.body12: Your contribution to the network is valued. But remember: every connection is a potential vulnerability.
emails.body13: Continue your work. But do so with caution.
emails.body14: The shadows are long, and they are listening.
